name: Test Harness & Smoke Tests
description: Vitest test harness and smoke test suite for the exemplar.tools documentation site. Delivers three file categories: (1) inline vitest configuration block in vite.config.ts specifying jsdom environment, setup files, globals, and include pattern; (2) src/__tests__/setup.ts as a side-effect-only module that registers @testing-library/jest-dom DOM matchers and afterEach cleanup; (3) two test files — src/__tests__/tools-data.test.ts for pure data invariant assertions against the canonical ToolDef array, and src/__tests__/component-render.test.tsx for leaf presentational component render smoke tests via @testing-library/react wrapped in MemoryRouter. All tests execute via `bunx vitest run` and must exit 0.

functions.name: createToolsDataTests
functions.description: Creates src/__tests__/tools-data.test.ts containing pure data smoke tests against the canonical ToolDef array imported from the tool-data component. Tests are pure functions with no DOM or network dependencies. Asserts: (a) array length === 11, (b) extracted slug set equals the canonical 11-variant ToolSlug set, (c) every entry satisfies RequiredToolFields structural contract, (d) kindex entry has videoUrl === undefined.

preconditions: tool-data component is implemented and exports a ToolDef[] array
ToolDef type includes fields: slug, name, description, step, version, accentColor, videoUrl (optional)
ToolSlug enum has exactly 11 variants
vitest globals are available (describe, it, expect) via globals: true config
postconditions: Test file imports ToolDef[] from the tool-data component — does NOT redefine any types
Contains a describe('tools data') block with at least 4 it() cases
Assert: Set of tools.map(t => t.slug) equals the canonical ToolSlug set (order-independent)
Assert: every tool has typeof name === 'string' && name.length > 0
Assert: every tool has typeof description === 'string' && description.length > 0

functions.name: createComponentRenderTests
functions.description: Creates src/__tests__/component-render.test.tsx containing smoke tests that verify at least one leaf presentational component renders without throwing. The component (Sidebar recommended) is wrapped in <MemoryRouter> to satisfy React Router context requirements. If the component depends on Convex hooks, vi.mock('convex/react') stubs are provided. Uses @testing-library/react render() and asserts DOM element presence.

structured_side_effects.description: Vitest reads test configuration from Vite config.
Vitest executes setup file before tests.
Vitest discovers and executes data smoke tests.
Vitest discovers and executes component render tests.
Vitest outputs test results and diagnostics to terminal.

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n = number of test cases

invariants: All test files import types from the tool-data component — they NEVER redefine ToolDef, ToolSlug, or any canonical type
setup.ts has zero exports — it is a pure side-effect module
The canonical slug set used in tools-data.test.ts must match the ToolSlug enum variants exactly and contain exactly 11 entries
Component render tests always wrap in <MemoryRouter> to satisfy React Router context
No test file imports from 'convex/react' directly without a vi.mock guard
vitest configuration must specify environment: 'jsdom' — not 'node' or 'happy-dom'
All package installation uses `bun add -d` — never npm, yarn, or npx
Test execution uses `bunx vitest run` — never `npx vitest` or global vitest
vite.config.ts modifications are additive — existing server, plugins, and build config are never removed
The test script in package.json must be exactly 'vitest run'
All test files reside under src/__tests__/ directory

data_access.rationale: Reads the PUBLIC-tier ToolDef[] array from the tool-data component to assert structural invariants (array length, slug completeness, required field presence, accentColor format, kindex videoUrl absence). No PII, INTERNAL, or SECRET data is accessed. Tests read component source files and configuration files, all of which are PUBLIC project artifacts. No writes to any data tier — tests are read-only verification.

side_effects.rationale: tools-data.test.ts imports and reads the tools array to verify all 11 entries have correct structural shape and the kindex entry lacks a videoUrl.
Test harness setup writes configuration files (vite.config.ts test block, setup.ts, test files, package.json test script) — all are PUBLIC project source artifacts.
Executes `bunx vitest run` as a child process for test suite verification. Reads project files, writes nothing to data stores.
installDevDependencies calls out to the npm registry to resolve and download vitest, jsdom, @testing-library/react, and @testing-library/jest-dom packages.

authority.rationale: This component is the sole authority for vitest test configuration (the test block in vite.config.ts, setup.ts, and test file structure) and for defining what smoke test assertions constitute a passing suite. No other component defines or modifies test infrastructure. The component does NOT own the ToolDef data domain — it only reads and asserts against it.
